system.description:
Favoured weapon: Flail, Heavy

Granted power: Tenet: Travel freely, and never cage what should fly.

  • Once per encounter, the first creature you hit, or that fails a save against your spell, is pushed 10ft and makes a Reflex save against your Class Save DC or falls Prone.
  • During a storm or rain this works once per round instead.
  • Once/day: call a lightning strike (3d6, Reflex save for half).

Allegiance: True Neutral, the god's alignment, held while the god favours you. Tenets: on Akadi in the World of Arneyan wiki.
